devices.notes: Blackmagic Videohub Mini 6x2 12G is a compact zero latency video router that supports any combination of SD, HD and Ultra HD on the router at the same time. It has 6 12G-SDI inputs and 2 12G-SDI outputs plus reference connections for locking clean switch outputs in a compact 1/2 rack width size. The front panel control panel lets you quickly route a video connection and even includes an emergency 12G-SDI connection for patching in external gear and USB-C webcam video out. It also features SDI re-clocking, external Ethernet control and supports all SDI video standards up to 2160p60. ports.name: Fixed 4K Inputs
ports.notes: Official P80 page: 'designed with 12x fixed concurrent 4K inputs' plus a swappable input card. Connectivity mentioned as HDMI 2.0, DP 1.2 and 12G-SDI, but the 12 fixed inputs are not broken down by connector on the extracted page — connector left unknown rather than guessed. Page also says 'up to 20x 4K inputs' including the optional card.

ports.name: Swappable 4K Input Card
ports.notes: Official: swappable input card options include a P_HDMI2.0_DP1.2_OPT Link Card and an 08 HDMI2.0+DP1.2+12G-SDI Input Card. Combined with the 12 fixed inputs, the page states up to 20x 4K inputs. Per-card connector counts were not fully parsed as numerals.

ports.name: HDMI Main Out
ports.notes: Official: 8x HDMI 2.0 main output connectors; up to 4x 4K concurrent outputs (copy mode) or 8x DL concurrent outputs (split mode).

ports.name: HDMI Flex Out
ports.notes: Official: '4x HDMI 2.0 for flex outputs' / '4x 4K flex outputs'.

ports.name: 12G-SDI Matrix Out
ports.notes: Official: '4x 12G-SDI matrix outputs'. Connector BNC not spelled out; marked medium for connector only.

ports.name: Multiviewer Out
ports.notes: Official: '2x dedicated Multiviewer outputs'. Connector not named.
